name: CUDA-OpenGL Interop Buffer Management
definition: Manages shared resources between CUDA and OpenGL using Pixel Buffer Objects (PBOs), textures, and Framebuffer Objects (FBOs) to enable zero-copy data exchange and avoid redundant host-device transfers.
summary: CUDA-OpenGL Interop Buffer Management manages shared resources like PBOs and textures to enable zero-copy data exchange and avoid redundant host-device transfers between the two APIs.
